R Notebook

db <- read_excel(here("data/dataform.xlsx"))
db <- na.omit(db)

db$ID <- as.factor(db$ID) 
db$Group <- as.factor(db$Group)

Visualization

long_db <- db %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(ID, Group), names_to = "Predictor", values_to = "Value")

# long_db %>%
#   ggplot(aes(x = ID, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
#   geom_boxplot() +
#   facet_wrap(~ Predictor, scales = "free_y") +
#   scale_fill_manual(values = c("#6996e3", "#dd5129")) +
#   theme_bw()

long_db %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Group, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ Predictor, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#6996e3", "#dd5129", "#2b9b81")) +
  theme_classic()


long_db %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ Predictor, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#6996e3", "#dd5129", "#2b9b81")) +
  theme_classic()


long_db %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ Predictor, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#6996e3", "#dd5129", "#2b9b81")) +
  theme_classic()

PCA


pca_res <- prcomp(db[,-c(1,2)], scale. = TRUE)

autoplot(pca_res, data = db, color = "ID", size = 3) +
  theme_classic()


autoplot(pca_res, data = db, color = "Group", size = 3, loadings = TRUE, loadings.label = TRUE) +
  theme_classic()


autoplot(pca_res, data = db, color = "Group", label = TRUE, shape = FALSE, label.label = "ID") +
  theme_classic()

Data Split

set.seed(2024)

db_ml <- db

# db_ml <- db %>%
#   select(-c(MeanArea, MeanPerim, BMitoRatio, TotBLengthMitoRatio, MeanBLength, BJunctMitoRatio, BEndPMitoRatio))

# db_ml <- db %>%
#   select(-c(MeanArea, MeanPerim, BMitoRatio, TotBLengthMitoRatio, MeanBLength, BJunctMitoRatio, BEndPMitoRatio))

# trnIndex <- createDataPartition(db_ml$ID, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

trnIndex <- createDataPartition(db_ml$Group, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

trn <- db_ml[trnIndex,]
tst <- db_ml[-trnIndex,]

trn[-c(1,2)] <- scale(log2(trn[-c(1,2)]))
tst[-c(1,2)] <- scale(log2(tst[-c(1,2)]))

LASSO Regression

Random Forest

set.seed(2024)

search_grid <- expand.grid(
  mtry = seq(1, 10, by = 1)
)

rf_model <- train(Group ~ .,
                  data = trn[-1], 
                  method = "rf",
                  tuneGrid = search_grid,
                  trControl = trainControl(method = "oob"),
                  ntree = 10000)

plot(rf_model)


rf_model$finalModel

Naive Bayes

search_grid <- expand.grid(
  usekernel = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  laplace = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  adjust = seq(1, 5, by = 1)
)

train_control <- trainControl(method="repeatedcv", number=10, repeats=3)

nb_model <- train(Group ~ .,
                  data = trn[-1], 
                  method = "naive_bayes",
                  trControl = train_control, 
                  # preProcess = c("pca"),
                  tuneGrid = search_grid)

plot(nb_model)


pred_gnb <- predict(nb_model, as.matrix(trn[-c(1,2)]), type = "raw")
confusionMatrix(pred_gnb, trn$Group, positive = "Disease")
